Name: GLOBAL:SOFAConventions
Comment: This conventions stores directivities of acoustic sources (e.g., loudspeakers, instruments, singers, talkers) in the time domain for single and multiple measurements, and under free field conditions.

Name: GLOBAL:DataType
Comment: We store emitter-dependent finite impulse response data here.

Name: GLOBAL:RoomType
Comment: The room information can be arbitrary, but the spatial setup assumes free field.

Name: GLOBAL:License
Default: No license provided, ask the author for permission

Name: GLOBAL:DatabaseName
Comment: Name of the database. Used for classification of the data

Name: GLOBAL:Description
Comment: Narrative description of a measurement including the device under test (e.g., source). For loudspeakers, the system and driver units, the measurement method or the standard used, e.g. AES56.

Name: GLOBAL:ReceiverDescription
Comment: Microphone model used to make the measurements (add serial number if possible).

Name: GLOBAL:SourceManufacturer
Comment: Manufacturer of the device under test.

Name: GLOBAL:SourceModel
Comment: Model of the device under test.

Name: GLOBAL:SerialNumber
Comment: Serial number of the device under test.

Name: GLOBAL:Symmetry
Comment: In which plane is the device under test considered symmetrical, e.g. None, horizontal, vertical, quarter, axial, right half, etc.

Name: Normalization
Comment: 0: No or unknown normalization; 1: Normalized relative to on-axis data (SourceView direction); 2. Per-direction normalization (data in each direction is normalized by a specific on-axis data). See standard for further information.

Name: Normalization:Description
Comment: Narrative explanation of the normalization.

Name: Normalization:References
Comment: Reference to publications describing the normalization.

Name: Normalization:URI
Comment: URIs or DOIs to publications describing the normalization.

Name: EmitterSensitivity
Dimensions: III, INI, IIE, MII, INE, MNI, MIE, MNE
Comment: Sensitivity of all specified emitters. Recommended for loudspeakers: The sensitivity of loudspeaker typically correspond to the on-axis response at 1m for speaker driven at 2.83V.

Name: EmitterSensitivity:Symbol
Comment: Abbreviated unit of the sensitivity. Recommended for loudspeakers: If sensitivity is provided, this shall be provided. either in Pa, or in dB SPL.

Name: EmitterSensitivity:Description
Comment: Narrative description of sensitivity. Recommended for loudspeakers: Describes the measurement method (i.e., at a distance of 1m and for a current of 2.83 V) and/or normalisation (i.e., measured in far field and referenced back to 1m and 2.83 V).

Name: EmitterMaxInputVoltage
Comment: Recommended for loudspeakers: The maximum input voltage (V_rms), following AES-2 recommandations. It can be given as a single broadband value, or different broadband values for each measurement, or as an impulse response to store frequency dependent values.

Name: EmitterMaxInputVoltage:Units
Comment: Narrative description of the maximum input voltage.

Name: EmitterMaxInputVoltage:Description
Comment: Recommended for loudspeakers: Describes the measurement method, e.g., following AES-2 recommandations, revision 2012.

Name: EmitterImpedance
Comment: Impedance of all or specific emitters. Recommended for loudspeakers: The minimum impedance (Ohm), can be given as a single broadband value, or single broadband value for each measurement, or as an impulse response to store frequency dependent values.

Name: EmitterImpedance:Units
Comment: Narrative description of the impedance.

Name: EmitterImpedance:Description
Comment: Recommended for loudspeakers: Describes the measurement method of the impedance, e.g., lowest point after resonance in the impedance response. Can also be the nominal impedance following AES-2 recommendations.

Name: EmitterMinOperatingFrequency
Comment: Minimum Frequency above which the source is supposed to operate. Recommended for loudspeakers: minimum frequency in the loudspeaker's operating frequency range defined in AES02-2012.

Name: EmitterMinOperatingFrequency:Units
Comment: Recommended for loudspeakers: If EmitterMinOperatingFrequency is provided this shall be provided as well. It shall be hertz

Name: EmitterMaxOperatingFrequency
Comment: Maximum Frequency above which the source is supposed to operate. Recommended for loudspeakers: maximum frequency in the loudspeaker's operating frequency range defined in AES02-2012.

Name: EmitterMaxOperatingFrequency:Units
Comment: Recommended for loudspeakers: If EmitterMaxOperatingFrequency is provided this shall be provided as well. It shall be hertz

Name: ListenerPosition
Comment: Fixed at [0 0 0], only the receiver position is varying.

Name: ListenerPosition:Type
Comment: Type of the coordinate system used.

Name: ListenerPosition:Units
Comment: Units of the coordinates.

Name: ListenerView
Comment: Orientation of the listener.

Name: ListenerView:Type
Comment: Type of the coordinate system used.

Name: ListenerView:Units
Comment: Units of the coordinates.

Name: ListenerUp
Comment: Up vector of the microphone array

Name: ReceiverPosition
Comment: Positions of the receiver around the device under test. The receivers are assumed to always be oriented toward the source.

Name: ReceiverPosition:Type
Comment: Type of the coordinate system used.

Name: ReceiverPosition:Units
Comment: Units of the coordinates.

Name: SourcePosition
Comment: In the case of loudspeaker and if following the AES56 convention, this should be the geometric center of the loudspeaker box (or the so-called point of rotation or point of reference).

Name: SourcePosition:Type
Comment: Type of the coordinate system used.

Name: SourcePosition:Units
Comment: Units of the coordinates.

Name: SourcePosition:Reference
Comment: Narrative description of the spatial reference of the source position, e.g., 'On the front plate between the low- and mid/high-frequency unit' for a loudspeaker. Mandatory in order to provide a reference across different sources.

Name: SourceView
Comment: View vector for the orientation.

Name: SourceView:Type
Comment: Type of the coordinate system used.

Name: SourceView:Units
Comment: Units of the coordinates.

Name: SourceView:Reference
Comment: Narrative description of the spatial reference of the source view, e.g., 'Viewing direction of the bell' for a trumpet or 'Perpendicular to the front plate' for a loudspeaker. Mandatory in order to provide a reference across different sources.

Name: SourceUp
Comment: Up vector of the acoustic source (loudspeaker or silentspeaker)

Name: SourceUp:Reference
Comment: Narrative description of the spatial reference of the source up, e.g., 'Along the keys, keys up' for a trumpet or 'Perpendicular to the top plate' for a loudspeaker. Mandatory in order to provide a reference across different sources.

Name: EmitterPosition
Comment: Position of the emitter relative to SourcePosition.

Name: EmitterPosition:Type
Comment: Type of the coordinate system used.

Name: EmitterPosition:Units
Comment: Units of the coordinates.

Name: Data.IR
Comment: Impulse responses

Name: Data.NormalizationIR
Dimensions: IIII, IIIE, IINI, IINE, IRII, IRIE, IRNI, IRNE, MIII, MIIE, MINI, MINE, MRII, MRIE, MRNI, MRNE
Comment: Impulse response(s) (or gain-factor) used for the normalization of Data.IR. The dimension depends on Normalization.

Name: Data.SamplingRate
Comment: Sampling rate of the samples in Data.IR and Data.Delay

Name: Data.SamplingRate:Units
Comment: Unit of the sampling rate

Name: Data.Delay
Comment: Additional delay of each IR (in samples)
